description_en: Invokes CreateLiveRoom to create a live room in the creation status
description_zh: 调用CreateLiveRoom创建状态为未开播的新直播
kebab_example: aliyun imp create-live-room --app-id 7m000q --title Title001 --notice Notice001 --cover-url http://000.png --extension AE350000T95F --anchor-id as0000hs --anchor-nick User001 --user-id as0000hs --enable-link-mic false --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLiveRoom

parameters.description_en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
